top_issues: Home: the On-chain/Reserve/Accounts legend under the total restates the same three numbers the stacked bar already encodes; it adds chips-as-text and kills premium quiet.
Home: Instant send/receive line duplicates Hub One's send/receive captions; two surfaces, one fact.
Home USDC row and Hub One bilateral bar are not on one absolute scale at a glance—the thin green+indigo total bar is ~1/3 the width of the 60k/40k account bar, so bigger bar is not more money.
Home: '1 px = $50 · auto · 2 empty hidden' is developer chrome in the primary viewport; it competes with $11,500.00.
Home: Pay/Receive/Swap cards are heavy bordered tiles; Pay fill is saturated blue (#5B6CFF-ish) not the stated indigo, and three equal tiles flatten hierarchy.
fixes: Home: drop the three-line legend; put a single muted caption under the total bar: 'Reserve $1,500 · Accounts $10,000'.
Home: draw the total stacked bar and the Hub One two-sided bar at the same 1px=$50 scale (or fade overflow); do not fit-to-card independently.
Home: move scale/empty-hidden to Settings only; keep at most a tap target on the total bar.
Home: make Pay a full-width primary; Receive/Swap as text+icon row, not twin cards.

top_issues: Home bottom + Home: Recent lists two identical 'Credit limit updated · 50,000.00 USDC' rows with no timestamp, frame, or before/after—noise, not activity.
Home bottom: USDC amount 11,500.00 has no $ and no tabular alignment vs Recent +10,000.00 USDC.
Home bottom: 'hub' chip next to Hub One is redundant with the H avatar and the Accounts section.
Home bottom: settled/updated/created status dots sit under amounts and wrap; status should be one quiet word, not a second column of pills.
Home + Activity: All activity is a blue text link while the tab bar already has Activity—two doors.
fixes: Collapse duplicate credit-limit events into one row with frame # and old→new limit.
Use one numeric style: tabular lining figures, always two decimals, $ only on fiat-total, token code only on token rows.
Remove the hub chip; keep the H glyph.
Drop All activity; let the Activity tab own the list.

top_issues: Pay: To card repeats Meridian Desk three times (green check, H1 title, wrapped 0x address)—address wrapping is the loudest element.
Pay: Amount '25' is unitless while CTA is 'Pay 25.00 USDC' and 'This payment 25.00' restates it; cursor artifact sits under This payment.
Pay: Hub One bar again uses full card width for 60k/40k while 25 USDC is invisible at 1px=$50—visceral value fails on the payment itself.
Pay: Route chips (You → Hub One → Meridian Desk) plus Fee/Arrives/Delivery Instant Change is a settings table on a send sheet; Arrives Instantly and Delivery Instant duplicate.
Pay + Home: tab bar remains on a focused Pay flow; thumb primary fights Home/Activity/Settings.
fixes: To: one name + truncated 0x on one line; green check as 8px status, not a second title.
Amount: large 25.00 with USDC in the field; delete This payment row.
Overlay a 25px (or 1px=$50) debit tick on the send half instead of re-showing the full 100k capacity bar as the hero.
Keep Route as one line of text; merge Arrives/Delivery; hide Fee if <0.01 unless expanded.
Hide tab bar on Pay/Receive/Swap; use back + CTA only.

top_issues: Receipt sheet: no value bar at all—25.00 is type-only, so visceral_value is absent on the proof screen.
Receipt: Settled 00:37:05 in 2736 ms mixes wall-clock and latency in one row; 2736 ms is engineer-facing.
Receipt: Proof 0x5db097be…d4c2 is truncated without copy; Frame #40 is unexplained next to it.
Receipt + Home (dimmed): Done is a grey filled block equal to a disabled control—primary after success should be quieter, not muddy.
Receipt: PAID + mint check is strong; keep it, but the sheet still shows X and a grabber plus Done.
fixes: Add a 25px mint bar (same scale as home) under the amount.
Settled: '37s · frame #40' or human time; move ms to a long-press debug.
Proof: full hash on tap + copy; one line 'Frame #40 · verified'.
One dismiss control: grabber or Done, not both plus X.

top_issues: Receipt-bottom: sheet covers BALANCES/ACCOUNTS but leaves the tab bar and a sliver of USDC 11,475.00—modal is not a real sheet; home numbers update behind glass.
Same receipt content issues as 03-receipt.png (no bar, 2736 ms, truncated proof).
Dimmed home still shows Open account and the bilateral bar—competing with PAID 25.00.
fixes: Sheet must cover tab bar or be a full-screen receipt; never leave Home/Activity/Settings tappable under a money modal.
If peeking home, freeze it; don't live-update 11,500→11,475 under the success state.

top_issues: Receive: QR is the hero but Amount 0.00 + unused indigo fade bar under it looks like a 40k receive capacity, not an invoice amount—scale lie.
Receive: SHARE paragraph is product copy in the payment path; Copy invoice / Copy link / Copy xln:// is three verbs for one request.
Receive: 0.00 grey placeholder is low contrast on white card; optional amount never invites a number pad.
Receive vs Pay: Pay has a page title+back; Receive bottom crop loses title—inconsistent chrome.
fixes: QR only until amount is set; draw invoice bar at 1px=$50 only when amount > 0.
One primary Copy link; invoice and xln:// under a single Share overflow.
Amount field: empty state 'Any amount' not 0.00; tap opens keypad.
Same header as Pay: back + Receive.

top_issues: Receive-bottom: QR is clipped at the top; the first thing in thumb-scroll is a truncated code—broken scan.
Receive-bottom: YOUR ENTITY ID is a wrapped 80-char hex block plus a second paragraph; lowest-contrast, highest-density trust object.
Receive-bottom + Settings: tab bar overlaps Entity ID text (ghosted hex behind Home/Activity/Settings).
Receive-bottom: Copy invoice/link sit above the fold while QR is incomplete—hierarchy inverted for a receive flow.
fixes: Pin QR fully visible below the header; never clip finder patterns.
Entity ID: 8…6 truncation + copy; full hex on tap.
Add safe-area padding so tab bar never occludes hex or copy.
If QR is the job, collapse SHARE until after first scroll.

top_issues: Swap: You pay 100 / You receive 0.00 with a live Swap CTA—user can appear to send 100 USDC for nothing; error prevention fails.
Swap: no value bars at all; 100 vs 0.00 is not visceral.
Swap: Same network / Across networks segmented control crowds the title; Across is disabled-looking grey on light.
Swap: USDC sandbox chip + WETH token chip + Hub One helper text is three location systems.
Swap: primary button is washed lavender (disabled styling) while still labeled Swap—state vs affordance collision.
Vast empty canvas below the CTA on mobile wastes the viewport without rate, impact, or account bar.
fixes: Disable Swap until receive > 0; label 'Enter amount to receive'.
Show both legs as 1px=$50 bars plus a rate line.
Move network toggle into the pair row, not the nav.
One venue: 'via Hub One · sandbox' under the pair, no sandbox chip on the token.

top_issues: Account: legend 'collateral / credit line / owed / in flight' sits above a bar that is only amber|indigo—green collateral and hatch in-flight are unused, so the legend is a key to missing ink.
Account: +9,975.00 they owe you vs send 59,975 / receive 40,025 — three numbers; the owed fill is a tiny end-cap on a 60k half, easy to miss vs the number.
Account: Pay / Extend credit / Swap repeats Home's three-up tiles; Extend credit is the account-specific action and should be primary here.
Account: THIS ACCOUNT table (Counterparty Hub, Network sandbox) plus truncated explainer under the tab bar—'credit line is your cap…' is cut off.
Account + Home: hub chip again; header already says Hub One.
fixes: Draw collateral (mint) and owed (amber) as actual fills; hide legend keys with zero width.
Make Extend credit the filled button; Pay/Swap secondary.
Don't clip the trust paragraph; move it above the tab bar or into Ledger detail.
Drop hub chip in the nav.

top_issues: Activity: filter chips All/Payments/Swaps/Settlement/Accou—last chip clipped; black All pill is the only dark object in a light app (theme inversion).
Activity: no amounts-as-bars; −25 vs +10,000 occupy the same visual weight except digits.
Activity: 5 movements includes two duplicate credit-limit rows and Account opened—filter 'Payments' would be the default for a wallet.
Activity vs Home Recent: same rows, extra chrome, still no time of day on TODAY.
Activity: Sent −25.00 USDC settled is good hierarchy; the rest of the list is admin events competing with money.
fixes: Default filter Payments; put limit/account events under Accounts chip.
Scroll chips with peek, don't crop Accou.
All chip: indigo outline/fill, not black, to match Light theme toggle language.
Optional 25px mint/amber ticks on payment rows at global scale.

top_issues: Activity detail vs 03-receipt: two receipt UIs (PAID 25.00 vs RECEIPT −25.00 USDC) for the same frame #40/proof—consistency and trust drift.
To line concatenates Meridian Desk 0x499d0d…f2bd without spacing/hierarchy; hex fights the name.
Time 00:37:05 is duration or clock? Same ambiguity as receipt Settled.
Proof truncation differs (…8ed4c2 vs …d4c2 on 03-receipt)—looks like two hashes.
No visceral bar; −25.00 is type only.
fixes: One receipt component for Pay success and Activity tap.
To: name, then muted truncated hex on the next column or subtitle.
Canonical proof truncation (first 6 … last 4) everywhere.
Label time as 'Settled 00:37:05' or absolute clock, not a naked timer.

top_issues: Settings: 1 px = $50 appears in the SCALE header and again beside the slider—duplicate.
Settings: Auto is a black pill like Activity All; $1–$100 chips clip $100; slider and chips encode the same control twice.
Settings: On-chain/Reserve/Accounts toggles are visibility flags named like balances—easy to read as turning off money, which is a trust hazard.
Settings: Theme Dark/Light control is a small segmented card; Light is selected with sun icon—fine—but Dark option uses a moon on white, low contrast.
Settings + 09-settings-bottom: RUNTIME section title is split across the fold under the tab bar.
fixes: One scale readout; slider OR chips, not both (chips as snaps under the slider).
Rename toggles 'Show on Home: On-chain / Reserve / Accounts'.
Don't clip $100; wrap a second row or make the chip row scroll with padding.
Keep Runtime block fully above the tab bar.

top_issues: Settings bottom: Reveal recovery phrase is a large pale button next to Lock—seed reveal is the highest-risk action and looks like a secondary toolbar.
Settings bottom: Runtime id full hex + Vault Sandbox/sandbox duplicate label; Frame #41 is unexplained.
Settings bottom: AT THIS SCALE card is the best visceral explainer in the set, but $100,000 = 2,000 px cannot exist on a phone—fade story is told in settings, not where bars break on Home.
Settings bottom: Lock and seed on the same row equalizes 'hide wallet' and 'show backup'.
fixes: Recovery phrase: nested behind Lock + confirm; never a peer of Lock.
Runtime id truncated + copy; drop duplicate 'sandbox' subtitle.
Put the fade/scale primer as a first-run tooltip on Home's total bar, not only here.

overall.verdict: Light mobile is a competent Cash App-adjacent shell with real proof cues (frame, runtime verify) but it is not yet a premium one-scale wallet: bars refit to cards, receipts have no bars, Swap is an unsafe empty state, and chrome (chips, legends, tab bar on modals, black All/Auto pills) keeps shouting. Trust is ahead of craft; visceral value and light-theme restraint are the gap to 800.
priority_fixes: Enforce one 1px=$N scale on Home total, token row, Hub One, Pay, Account, and a 25px tick on receipts; never independently fit bars to card width.
Delete repeating legends/chips (On-chain/Reserve/Accounts text, hub chip, Instant line vs account captions, scale debug on Home).
Hide the tab bar on Pay/Receive/Swap/receipt sheets and stop clipping QR, Entity ID, Activity Accou, and Settings Runtime.
Block Swap until receive > 0; unify Pay success and Activity receipt into one component with copyable canonical proof.
Rebind light theme: no black All/Auto pills, no grey Done-as-disabled, seed reveal demoted, Pay primary = indigo #6E7CFF not saturated blue tiles.
